### The Session in Three Acts

**Act 1 — Asian session and pre-CPI rally (00:00–12:00 UTC):** BTC opened at $63,700 and spent 12 hours drifting higher as pre-CPI positioning accumulated. Volume was light (18-84 BTC per hour) — speculative, not institutional. The session high of $64,431 was reached at 12:00 UTC, peaking as the CPI data was released at 8:30 ET (12:30 UTC). Notably, the pre-CPI session high of $64,431 was $569 below $65,000 — even at maximum optimism, the market didn't price a clean $65,000 recovery.

**Act 2 — Post-CPI sell wave (13:00–14:00 UTC):** Two consecutive sell candles:
